subject: general
question: Which international organization launched the AIM4NatuRe initiative to improve monitoring of ecosystem restoration?

options.text: International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) launched AIM4NatuRe to enhance the monitoring and reporting of global ecosystem restoration efforts.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **FAO launched the AIM4NatuRe initiative on Earth Day, with GBP 7 million from the United Kingdom to improve ecosystem restoration monitoring.**
 
• AIM4NatuRe aims to provide technical expertise and resources to countries, helping them track and report ecosystem restoration progress accurately.
 
• The initiative will complement the existing AIM4Forests programme and focus on a range of ecosystems, from reforestation to marine restoration.
 
• AIM4NatuRe prioritizes data interoperability, enabling global collaboration and enhancing transparency in restoration efforts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
